Liam —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Short answers up front:
- For non-US entities the W-8BEN-E is the correct form; we do not request a W-9 unless the supplier is a US person or has US tax nexus.
- The field we validate is the "Foreign TIN" (box 8) for an Irish entity; VAT is helpful for invoicing but not used by Tax Ops as the primary crosscheck.

That said, our Tax Ops team will need either a registry extract (showing the exact legal name + registration number) or a gov-issued TIN confirmation to resolve the formatting mismatch. If BrightBridge prefers, a notarized attestation or a screenshot from the Companies Registration Office with the exact name will suffice.

Looping in Neha (Tax Ops) and Karthik (Legal) to advise on the minimum acceptable evidence and whether any temporary withholding should be applied pending verification.

Next steps for BrightBridge: please provide either: 1) registry extract OR 2) government TIN confirmation PDF. If you can get that by EOD tomorrow we can keep the PO on schedule.

Thanks,

Hi all —

Quick tax-ops note and minimum evidence checklist to resolve the TIN/name discrepancy so we can clear the PO without withholding:

Minimum acceptable items (one of the following):
- Official company registry extract (timestamped within last 6 months) showing legal name and registration number; OR
- Government-issued TIN confirmation letter (Ireland Revenue) showing entity name and TIN; OR
- Certified/attested copy of certificate of incorporation plus a recent VAT registration showing matching name/number.

If none of the above are available, we can accept a notarized statement + bank account statement showing the company name, but that will trigger a manual review and may lead to temporary 30% withholding per policy until resolved.

Technical notes for procurement processing:
- Please ensure the W-8BEN-E has the Foreign TIN populated in box 8 and the legal name exactly matches the registry extract. Minor punctuation (commas/full stops) is acceptable, but differing legal entity endings (e.g., "Ltd" vs "Limited") must be clarified.
- If BrightBridge has a US tax agent or EIN for a US branch that Redwood will pay, we will need a W-9 for that US entity specifically.

Liam — if you can upload the registry extract to the Drive link below or reply with a PDF we will triage immediately. If you prefer secure upload, use the DocuSign/secure channel link.

Drive upload: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C-presupplier-decl
Secure sign/upload: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/example-signature-session
